It offers a range of amenities and services, including restaurants, beauty and spa treatments, event planning and services, and outdoor seating. The hotel features multiple dining options and a rooftop lounge, as well as a fitness center, pool, and spa. The hotel also offers various activities and events, such as wine tastings, art classes, and live music performances. Reviewers have praised the hotel's beautiful setting, excellent service, and comfortable rooms. Some have also commented on issues with the TV and parking valet. Overall, The Ritz-Carlton Bacara, Santa Barbara appears to be a popular destination for those looking for a luxurious and relaxing vacation.

source_info.name: The Ritz-Carlton Bacara, Santa Barbara
source_info.categories: Restaurants, Beauty & Spas, American (New), Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Massage, Resorts, Day Spas, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

review_info.review_text: Beautiful setting. Nice addition to the chain. Great service by Jon! Food was good. And the ambiance was nice too.

Only a solid THREE STARS. 

I will put in details for my review here. This review is not biased, pure 100%  our experience staying at Ritz Carlton Bacara Santa Barbara. 

Ritz Carlton SB is not located in a prime area. This is a resort,  their property is isolated away from downtown so that customers can enjoy the activities that the resort provides, such as hiking by the beach, biking around the hotel area. Mind you, this hotel is not walkable to restaurants in SB, they provided their own chain restaurants to make guests enjoy and relax at the property.

Here is our experience:
Like any other experienced travellers, we booked our hotels through credit card partners using our mileage. Who pay their hotel rooms in full nowadays anyways? Most smart people pay their hotel rooms with points or mileage affiliated with credit cards company. Originally we booked for double beds. However a day before, I received an email from them that my room was changed to single bed. This is quite impossible to our situation since we have 2 adults and 2 children. So I called (many times) to our credit card company and to Ritz to make sure we would get 2 double beds instead of 1 single king bed. The number of phone calls to change the number of beds did not happen only in one call, unfortunately. I had to call them several times before our arrival. 

So, arrival day, we got our 2 double beds. Perfect. Checking in was a smooth process. The receptionist was polite, explaining us everything about the resort. By the way, the resort has so many activities that you could book first through their website. And I also appreciate the concierge emailed us days before reminding us about the activities on the days we stay. (Tips: the receptionist offered us a transportation like a luggage cart to transport the guests to your villas, ACCEPT IT! Ritz carlton property is so huge that you can even get lost in the area. You can walk if you want to reach your 10k steps, though). 

When we got to our hotel, problem arise. Tv did not work. I called the receptionist, and the technician came after an hour later. They tried their best to fix tv, unfortunately the problem was much bigger than they expected. The sad part was they KNEW the tv was broken already and Ritz didn't even solve the problem. (Technician told me our previous guest also had the same problem - broken tv). So, me just being me, asking for a compensation for the broken tv. The technician was very generous giving us $100 restaurant fee.  And I took it with my grateful heart. 

Resort wise; this property again has a lot activities that you can do with your kids, partners, etc. Hiking by the beach is the most popular activities done by my people. Biking around the area also a great thing to do. 

During check out time, there was a bit problem since I wanted to redeem the $100 certificate that the technician gave me. A bit miscommunication happened at that time, but they resolved it quickly.

Would I recommend you guys to stay here? if you have $1000 extra to spare for staying a night here, sure you should. 
Don't forget to add
Parking vallet is $53 a day
Resort fee is $50 a day. (that's why maximise the property since you're charged hefty for resort fee). 

Other than that, yes I would stay again here. Hopefully I can bump this review to 4 star next time.

Amazing hotel with such such comfy rooms. We had a iv and there was an area right outside the room where he could go in the morning..so so convenient..there was a small lawn with a gorgeous fountain right outside the room which was awesome. The GYM WAS BEYOND FANTASTIC!!! the views were great. Service was great at the coffee shop and the bar. Room service we got it in the lobby was great. THE YUCCA FRIES ARE A MUST Have!!! The chips and guacamole were totally yum! We got takeout in the lobby and hung out which was so fun! Having a fridge and microwave in the room was so helpful. We will definitely come back. Highly recommend!

review_info.review_text: One of the best restaurants and Mediterranean food I've ever had!! They are very clean and the employees there are very nice and good energy as well as the owner.. I'm definitely going back. DEFINITELY RECOMMEND!!

Honestly i cant describe this place. It is one of my favorite stops in SB. The shawarma Sandwich taste sooo good and the hummus is the best. Alo the fried chicken was something else. Crispy and Halal. The staff are so friendly and the vibes are super. Will definitely come back. This place is super awesome.

We were excited to try this place out, but we're extremely disappointed. The service was slow, it seemed like there were only two people working. The silverware was not very clean. The ambiance was awkward, very quiet, like a doctors office lobby. The beef schwarma sandwich was not good at all. The meat had no flavor, couldn't taste any seasonings. It was also wrapped in a tortilla. A tortilla??! While the menu says "flat bread." I was hoping that at least the baklava would be good, but it was so dry. The hummus that came with the schwarma wasn't that great, either. The Turkish coffee was decent though. Would not recommend and will not come back. 1 star for being ambitious enough to open a new restaurant in town.

response: The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf is a food and beverage establishment located at 811 State St, Santa Barbara, CA. This business is categorized under Food, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, and operates from 6:30 AM to 9 PM on weekdays, 7:30 AM to 10 PM on Saturdays, and 7:30 AM to 9 PM on Sundays. The venue offers free WiFi, outdoor seating, and take-out services. However, it does not provide any parking facilities or accept restaurant reservations. The business has an average rating of 3.5 stars. Customers have highlighted the eco-friendly approach, such as the usage of paper straws. However, there have been instances of awkward customer service. Others have praised the store's transparency in displaying the nutritional information of their drinks and the management's friendly approach.

review_info.review_text: I entered the Santa Barbara De la Vina store on 5/17 around 3 p.m. It was manned by two males. I made the mistake of bringing in my own cup to reuse. Before I could finish my sentence one of the figures asks me if I have a receipt. Now how many of you carry around a Coffee Bean receipt with you? He was under the impression I was trying to save a dollar or so. I corrected him saying I was trying to be sensitive to the environment. It was awkward. Seems like a minor thing and it is, but during the pandemic you'd think the first thing out of an employee's mouth is not asking to see my receipt and it's the only CBT store that's ever done so. BTW, they use paper straws so you'd think they'd get the environment thing.

First of all, this location is quite small and cute, and the service was p friendly!! I appreciate how they use paper straws! As a positive, they are super upfront about the nutrition of their drinks, with each item on the menu labeled with its calories. They also have lightened versions of drinks like their matcha latte if you want a lower cal option. I think this is so helpful! 
I ordered a Vietnamese cold brew, and would recommend! Not quite the authentic Vietnamese coffee you would get at other places, but pretty close! Super rich and a good source of caffeine if you need it :) Not very many interesting options on the drink menu, tho. A pretty standard coffee shop I would say.

I had such a great experience at this coffee bean and tea leaf. Christine the store manager was awesome!
As I got my drinks sitting against the window with my mom she checked in to make sure our drinks were good... that meant a lot! What a great attitude she has!

review_info.review_text:
Fun spot with multiple pool tables in the back. 

If you're local this is one of the spots where you will probably know most of the people inside on a busy Friday or Saturday night. 

Patty in the front is awesome as always.

We brought my mother-in-law for lunch.  She is English and we were relieved that she enjoyed the food.  The food was hearty and we were very full.  It's a very spacious and clean pub.  They also had outdoor dining.  We had very good service.

Finally, an Irish pub that can actually pour a proper pint of Guinness in southern California.  It is nice to see they actually have a legit nitro system, comparable to the ones from Ireland.  

This is a good place to grab a bite away from the hustle and bustle of state street.  There were plenty of available tables and no wait for dinner. 
This fish and chips were solid along with the steak pie.  Also had chicken tenders off the kids menu and my daughter had no complaints. 

4 stars.

response: Stacky's Seaside is a casual dining restaurant located at 2315 Lillie Ave, Summerland, CA. It is known for its "insane breakfast burritos" and fish and chips as described by customers. The restaurant is also praised for its decor and comfortable, beachy ambiance. The outdoor seating area, which includes picnic benches and a boat, is a highlight for many patrons. Stacky's Seaside offers menu options that are good for groups and also provides take-out services. However, it doesn't offer Wi-Fi or parking facilities other than street parking. The restaurant, which has been in business since approximately 1985, operates daily from 6:30 to 19:30. It has an average rating of 3.5 stars with some customers rating it as high as 5 stars.

review_info.review_text: Drove by this weekend and was bummed to see that Stacky's is closed. They had very good "insane breakfast burritos" and I enjoyed their fish and chips too. Loved the fact that you could sit in a boat outside on their patio and eat. Found out about this place in 2007. It was a lovely little hole in the wall that had been there for 30 years as of April 2015 (since approx. 1985). Was reading that in April 2015 Rusty's Pizza bought the location and was planning to open a Rusty's Summerland in the same spot.

I have been going to this place for so many years now, always visiting after bringing my kids  swimming at the beach, to now bringing their kids (my grandchildren) on a beautiful day.
I have always loved their decor, so beachy and comfortable. Outside is like on a picnic bench! The best part is they offer 1/2 sandwiches, for 1/2 price....not more costly for the trouble, and leaving you the option of getting a bit of this sandwich and a bit of that. That was always my favorite reason! My kids ordered the fish n' chips last time we visited, and they said it was so delicious. I  love their great selection of sandwiches, so creatively combined, like 'The Griller' or the New Yorker...and many more.....Unfortunately, I think their hours and days open have changed, so it's wise to check before going. We tried this past Friday @ 3 p.m. and they were closed. Hopefully, it is not closing, after so many years around. Over 20 yrs. visiting for me....
It will forever be a favorite of mine.
Thanks Yelp for the recommendation! The fish and chips were the best we've ever had!! The onion rings were delicious too!

response: Minnow Cafe is a local business located at 9 Breakwater in Santa Barbara, CA. It falls under the categories of restaurants and delis. The cafe has a rating of 4.0 stars. Customers have left positive reviews about the quality of seafood offered at the cafe. One customer mentioned that they enjoyed the clam chowder bread bowl and fish and chips, praising the freshness and taste of the food. The cafe also offers outdoor seating, allowing customers to enjoy their meals near the harbor, close to the ocean. This feature is appreciated by customers who want to dine quickly and have more time to explore other areas of Santa Barbara. However, there are also some negative reviews mentioning high prices for what is perceived as average fast food. The cafe has a casual ambience and offers takeout options. The parking lot is available for customers, but street and garage parking are not provided. Overall, Minnow Cafe is known for its seafood options and convenient location near the harbor.

review_info.review_text:
This place is perfect to get some seafood in Santa Barbara! I was glad to be able to find this hole in a wall while walking with my group for lunch. 

I ordered the clam chowder bread bowl and fish and chips. Clam chowder was very delicious and fresh. The fish was crispy and made into perfection. 

The best part is that you can order the food right away and simply sit at the tables outside to eat near the harbor where the ocean is so close. So if you want to get food in a quickly manner in order to have more time to explore the other areas in Santa Barbara, I would highly recommend Minnow Cafe.
Hard to beat for a fast-food-type breakfast or lunch at the marina. Simple, good food, well prepared.

I really like the Minnow...I mean you can't beat the location for a fast food establishment and the Fish Tacos are pretty good...BUT I'm always horrified to discover how much this fast food experience costs.  I mean, it's really not very good food unless you view it as cheap (but it's not).  Great thing, sitting outside by the harbor watching the BPs go by while you eat cheap (seeming) food.  Bad part, greasy spoon food served on paper plates by snarky staff with condiments that blow away...but it ain't cheap.  Guess that's Santa Barbara.

Santa Barbara Bay Cafe is a local seafood restaurant located at 131 Anacapa St, Santa Barbara, CA. The restaurant offers a variety of seafood dishes and has received mixed reviews from customers.

One customer commented that the restaurant was an "awesome spot to grab a bite to eat" and praised the quality of the seafood. They specifically recommended the swordfish and mentioned enjoying it with a pint of Central California's Finest Firestone Ale. Another customer, however, had a disappointing experience. They found the clam chowder to be watery and lacking in flavor, and the oysters Rockefeller to be dominated by a thick layer of melted cheese. They felt that the dish missed the mark and suggested it should be called "oysters Velveeta" instead.

Despite the mixed reviews, another customer, who is a local resident, believes that Santa Barbara Bay Cafe has the best seafood in town. They advised not to overlook the specials offered by the restaurant, as they have tried them and found them to be fantastic.

Overall, Santa Barbara Bay Cafe is a seafood restaurant in Santa Barbara that has received both positive and negative feedback from customers.

review_info.review_text:
Awesome spot to grab a bite to eat. This place is legit for the mere fact that it is very unassuming. We chose this spot because it was a market/restaurant. From my experience fish is best cooked and prepared by those who are in the market of selling it. I ordered the swordfish along with a pint of Central Calfornia's Finest Firestone Ale.   
I would recommend this to anyone who wants to relax and indulge in great seafood.

This was our lunch stop during the Captain Jack's winery tour.  It was fairly disappointing even though we kept our choices simple.  I had a cup of clam chowder and a serving of the oysters Rockefeller.  The clam chowder was off in its flavors.  It was a touch more watery than I would have liked.  I also did not come away with a nice rich, buttery flavor; this offering was much less nuanced, pedestrian in nature.  Clam was seldom seen throughout.  The oysters were definitely a miss.  These were not the famous ones from Antoine's.  The variation here was a very thick layer of melted cheese spiked with spinach or was that chives?  I couldn't tell, because the only thing I could taste was cheese.  It even dominated the natural taste of the ocean in the oysters entirely which really misses the point of the dish.  It is called Rockefeller because it is a very rich dish.  This was clunky.  Worse, one could simply scrape off the layer of coagulated cheese and just eat the oyster.  There was no melding of flavors, no subtleness to it at all.   A better name for this dish would have been oysters Velveeta.  Pass.
We are Santa Barbara locals.  I think they have the best seafood in town.  Don't over look the specials they offer.    I have tried them and they are fantastic!

response: Domingo's Cafe is a cozy local eatery located in Goleta, California, offering a variety of breakfast and brunch options, including Mexican and American favorites. With a rating of 4.0 stars and numerous positive reviews, customers appreciate the cafe's home-style feel, comfortable seating both indoors and outdoors, and friendly service. Standout menu items include breakfast burritos, omelets, and fresh fruit cups, as well as the option to customize dishes to suit individual preferences. While some reviewers have noted minor issues with food temperature and toilet maintenance, overall, Domingo's Cafe appears to be a popular and enjoyable destination for both locals and visitors alike.

review_info.review_text: I love local places and this is it! Home style feel and nice little breakfast cafe.  Breakfast burritos are on point! Maybe one of the best in town with crispy hash browns, eggs cooked just right, and the perfect amount of cheese! I like to get the spicy salsa to top it off.

What a friendly morning breakfast spot chock full of locals with their families. Seating is available both inside and out. My bacon avocado cheese omelet was very good. The fresh mellon berry cup I asked for on the side was so full of fresh fruit flavor. The toasted sour dough bread was wonderfully crusty and lightly buttered, however it came to me cold. 
My companion asked for the salsa verde with his meal. Be careful. It's very picante!
Apple Pay is taken. I used the restroom and found the toilet actively leaking. Apparently, it's an ongoing issue.  
All in all, there were a few issues, but no deal breakers here. Enjoy!

Everyone enjoyed brunch.  Sons had the pancake special. Wife had the mash substituted sausage for ground beef.  And I had tuna melt with grilled onions.   Next time we are in Santa Barbara we will return

response: Harbor of Santa Barbara Inc, located at 210 Stearns Wharf in Santa Barbara, CA, is a business that combines aspects of active life, restaurants, and boating. The company has an average rating of 3.5 stars. Customer reviews highlight concerns about the environmental impact of the restaurants' use of plastic straws and the high dockage fees. Some visitors also felt the place seemed elitist and not welcoming unless you have a lot of money. However, one reviewer noted the appeal of the decent-sized pier for walking and watching fishermen and rowers, as well as the presence of shops and restaurants. It's a spot recommended for tourists who wish to experience California's beaches.

Peebee & Jays is a local sandwich restaurant located at 1007 Casitas Pass Rd in Carpinteria, CA. The restaurant specializes in sandwiches and falls under the categories of Sandwiches and Restaurants. The business operates from Monday to Saturday, with hours from 10:30 am to 4:00 pm.

According to customer reviews, the sandwiches at Peebee & Jays are highly praised for their quality and taste. Customers recommend opting for soft rolls with the Bacon Went on a Date sandwich and adding turkey. However, there is a negative review that mentions issues with the cauliflower flatbread, which is described as flimsier compared to the other sandwiches.

In terms of amenities, Peebee & Jays offer outdoor seating and takeout services. They do not provide WiFi, and reservations are not available. The business parking includes a parking lot but does not have a garage, street parking, or valet services.

It is important to note that the restaurant has received a 4.0-star rating, indicating a generally positive customer experience. However, there is also a negative review regarding customer service, specifically mentioning unresponsiveness and a negative attitude from the workers.

Overall, Peebee & Jays is known for its delicious sandwiches, although there have been some issues with certain menu items and customer service.

review_info.review_text: Their sandwiches are fantastic, but don't opt for the cauliflower flatbread. They pack so much into these sandwiches that the flatbread can't handle it, so you're paying extra for a flimsier sandwich. I've also had trouble getting all my points for my weekly purchases. Their system is confusing, and they were unresponsive after multiple attempts to fix it. That said, their sandwiches are all great. Go for soft rolls with the Bacon Went on a Date and add turkey. So good.

I got a lot pb with honey and a Nutella pb with marshmallow fluff they were pretty good the only real issue I had was that the crust was rubbery and hard to but into but over all it was super delicious

I will never go back to this location again. The workers in general have a negative attitude and think the customers owe them a medal for showing up to work. I placed a pick up order and put on the special instructions for the Mayo and Mustard to be on the side. Well, I got my sandwich and it was drenched in Mayo, something I wanted to avoid. I called them and the employee told me they could remake it. I threw the sandwich away and about 15 mins later got a call and was told that I had to bring the sandwich back. I told them I already tossed it in the garbage then the employee put his manager on the line and she was so RUDE and said that I need to bring it back ( I wasn't about to dig through the trash) and I said that the employee never said anything about bringing the sandwich back in the first conversation and he should have said something and expect me to still have it. And she said very unprofessionally, "well he didn't know." I told her that is a failure on the training and not the customer. She then said that next time I need to specifically write the word "everything" on the side instead of using commas as I did. This manager is absolutely disgusting and clearly has no basic customer service skills. 

This isn't the first time my pick up order has been destroyed. But the way that "manager" spoke to me and handledis why I will NEVER go there again and will tell all my coworkers to stay away. 

To the owner of this location: good Managers are hard to come by but you can absolutely do better then who was working on 10/13/21 @ 12:30 pm. She is horrible at her job and will continue to drive away customers with her terrible attitude.

Longboard's Grill is a local business located at 210 Stearns Wharf in Santa Barbara, CA. It falls under the categories of Nightlife, Seafood, American (Traditional), Bars, and Restaurants. The business offers a variety of seafood dishes and American cuisine. 

The restaurant is open from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM from Monday to Thursday, 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM on Fridays, 11:00 AM to 9:00 PM on Saturdays, and 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM on Sundays. 

Longboard's Grill provides outdoor seating for customers and offers takeout services. It is suitable for groups and has a casual and classy ambience. The business also offers valet parking for its customers. However, there is no WiFi available in the restaurant. 

According to customer reviews, Longboard's Grill has received mixed feedback. One customer praised the freshness and taste of the oysters, giving the place a 5-star rating. However, another customer had a negative experience with their fish and chips, describing the fish as low quality and unpleasant in taste. Additionally, a Thanksgiving dinner at the restaurant was disappointing for another customer, who felt the service was discriminatory and lacked information about specials. 

Overall, Longboard's Grill has a rating of 3.0 stars, with positive reviews for its oysters but negative feedback regarding the fish and chips and Thanksgiving dinner experience.

review_info.review_text: The Oysters were fascinating, and the place itself was fantastic too! Myself, is a Oyster's lover, and this place has proved it. The Oysters are very fresh and tasty too, will recommend it to any people that are a big fan of Oysters or seafood. 5-star rating from me to this place.

I took my granddaughter here today & deeply regret it.  At the first bite I should have refused it and moved on but I didn't want to upset my granddaughter who was hungry.  We both had fish & chips.  The fish was so bad that I asked the waiter what kind it was.  He said " it's red snapper, does it taste funky ?"  I'd like the restaurant to prove that wasn't the lowest quality tilapia on the market.  It tasted like metal and mud. The manager & owner should take some home to their families & see the reaction. It's vile.  The whole place is run down & I should have left immediately.

Thanksgiving dinner was awful. Service was discriminatory and catered to others much more. Was given plastic cutlery and nobody even gave us menus. 
Had to get my own menu, find a server and nobody told us about any specials. 
Absolutely ruined my day and would request you to go somewhere else unless you like to be disappointed.

review_info.review_text: This place really made my hemorrhoids flare up. The food came pretty quickly but unfortunately for me it wreaked havoc on my stomach. Within one hour of finishing my food I found myself sitting on a public toilet in downtown Santa Blahblah between a movie theater and a Marshells. Pattaya Thai Restaurant is a casual dining establishment located at 5918 Hollister Ave, Goleta, CA. Known for serving Thai cuisine, the restaurant operates from 5 PM to 9 PM from Tuesday to Sunday. Facilities include a parking lot and it accommodates group dining as well as offers takeout services. However, it does not offer WiFi and the ambiance is not classified as trendy, upscale, or hipster. The restaurant has an average rating of 3.5 stars. 

Customer reviews indicate mixed feelings about the restaurant. Some visitors have complained about the lack of ambiance, poor service, and issues with food quality, including a case of food poisoning from the spicy fried rice. On the other hand, a customer praised the well-cooked chicken and shrimp in their Pad Thai, despite finding the dish a bit bland.

review_info.review_text: Went in for lunch and felt like I'd gone back in time. Service was lousy. The place was dark. An upgrade is sorely needed. Few customers. And you couldn't smell anything cooking despite the noise from the kitchen. Waited for server so I left!
Food poisoning. Ordered the spicy fried rice and it tasted bad, spicy in areas badly seasoned and food poisoning to follow. HORRIBLE.

As you can tell, I am a big fan of Pad Thai lol. This time is a Pad Thai from Pattaya Thai, and despite the chicken and shrimp being cooked very well and not overcooked, I unfortunately found this Pad Thai to be a bit bland. Now I have high standards for Pad Thai, but I know Pattaya is able to deliver better results. The flavors were all there, but with Pad Thai it is easy for there to be not enough flavor, which makes the dish taste terrible. This was alright.

Averaged from my last review, this is 4 stars.

response: O'Malleys Bar, located at 523 State St in Santa Barbara, CA, is a local establishment offering nightlife, bars, and sports bars services. It operates throughout the week, with hours extending until 1:30 am. Street parking is available, and the bar offers outdoor seating and free WiFi. The venue also takes reservations and accommodates larger groups. However, it does not have a music system. Despite having an average business rating of 2.5 stars, customer reviews are mixed. Some patrons have expressed dissatisfaction with the bar staff's conduct and alleged fraudulent billing practices. Others, however, have praised the bar's team, its abundance of TVs for sports viewing, and reasonably priced drinks, making it a frequent visit for them. The bar's ambience leans more towards being a 'divey' place rather than trendy or upscale.

review_info.review_text: This place is horrible! The bouncers were incredibly rude and saying disturbing things to me. I left the bar and had come back for them to give me a hard time about coming in again. I asked for their names and they responded "I don't have to tell you shit". Worst night of my life. I went home crying after the horrible stuff that was said to me.  I will never be coming here again or recommending this place to anyone. If you enjoy bouncers taking advantage of you and their job then this is the place to go. Sharkeez right next door was way more accommodating, if your looking for a safe bar with friendly people, I would recommended Sharkeez.

My son was a groomsman at a wedding in Santa Barbara on October 10, 2021, a Sunday night.  After the reception, around 11:30 pm, a couple of the guests went to O'Malleys for a drink.  My son's bar bill was $40 and he added a $15 tip.  O'Malleys' added $400 to his credit card for a total of a $455 charge.  This is FRAUD and THEFT.  I called OMalleys' numerous times, leaving a name and phone number since they don't answer their telephone - with no reply.  I am shocked and dismayed by this outright theft.  DO NOT PATRONIZE THIS BAR, their employees are dishonest and thieves.

I know, I know.... People might be shocked to see that O'Malley's gets a five star rating from me.   More on that later.  

O'Malley's is hard to categorize which I believe is the reason it is not carrying a higher Yelp rating.   I would describe it as a "neighborhood bar located at ground zero of tourist central".  Some would call it a dive bar, it isn't.   I am a bit of a dive bar connoisseur and O'Malley's falls short or more accurately elevates above the standard of dive bar.   Mostly for the lack of bar flys sitting at the counter at 11:00am.  

They have an amazing team, many who have worked here for years and are loved by SB locals.   Duane and Katie are fabulous and today as I write this Haley is working!   She just made me an amazing margarita.  

Now, why five stars? Because I come here so freakin' much.   How could I ever knock off a star for a place I frequent many times in a month.  SB falls short in the sports bar department and O'Malleys has TV's in abundance!  Inside, on the patio and now out front on State Street.   Whether you love football, Dodger games or European Soccer they have it on.   If you are visiting SB you might have noticed it is not uncommon to pay $16 for a drink, not O'Malley's, I don't know how many times I got my bill and said "we ordered five drinks" and heard them respond "yes, they are all on there".  As a tourist you might find O'Malley's to be a little unkept for the fancy SB vibe you are used to, but come back on your next visit, and then your next.   I'm sure you will embrace it as I do.

response: Valentino's Take N Bake Pizza is a restaurant located at 4421 Hollister Ave in Santa Barbara, CA. They offer sandwiches, salads, and pizza as their main menu items. Their hours of operation are Monday through Saturday from 11:00 am to 9:00 pm. They have parking available on site and do not offer reservations or outdoor seating. However, they do provide takeout options and are good for groups. Customers have praised their freshly made sandwiches, especially the Italian sub. They also appreciated the convenience of being able to pick up their pizzas at any time and bake them when ready. Valentino's has received positive reviews for their consistent quality of food and great service, with particular mention going to employee Shayre. Overall, Valentino's Take N Bake Pizza appears to be a well-regarded establishment in the Santa Barbara area for its convenient takeout options and delicious sandwiches.

review_info.review_text:
I don't know what took me so long to find this place but I love it. First off, they don't just make pizzas to go, they make amazing sandwiches! The Italian sub is by far my favorite. The rolls taste fresh and the meats are perfect! The combination of everything in the sandwich is just amazing! I'm not even a fan of sandwiches but this is my first choice of food there! 

Okay so the pizzas. I used to question why anyone would want to make their own pizza. Isn't the point to pay for someone to do the work for you? I moved beyond my high maintenance thinking after eating a pizza at a friend's house. It's NOT that difficult to throw it in the oven and the instructions are right on the packaging. The pizza came out of the oven smelling amazing and it was perfectly cooked! I took a bite and my goodness! Fresh baked pizza with little work put in! No cold pizza getting delivered to your house...just a yummy pizza perfectly cooked. And you can pick it up any time, put it in the fridge, and baked when you're ready for dinner! Genius! I appreciate the fresh ingredients and warm pizza. I can't pick a favorite pizza because they've all been amazing. Just go try one then try a second then a third...you won't regret it!
Always can depend on Valentino's for delicious food! Have been coming here since I was a kid and the food has consistently been tasty over all these years! Great sandwiches, pizzas and salads!

Hands down Shayre is an angel! This was our second time ordering a bulk order from this establishment and she got it done! We ordered 120 half sandwiches (100 turkey and 20 veggie) for new student orientation. She informed me that early bread deliveries recently have been tight bc of the pandemic, but the sandwiches were prepared and ready to go when I arrived! Shayre is such a sweet, hardworking individual and I highly recommend Valentino's for any event!

The restaurant offers a casual ambiance and is good for groups. However, it doesn't provide WiFi and outdoor seating, though it offers take-out services and accepts reservations. Parking is available on the street and in a dedicated lot. It operates from 11 am till midnight from Tuesday to Sunday, with an exception on Monday when it remains closed. The business has received mixed reviews from customers, with an average rating of 3 stars. One customer praised the pizza as being worth it for quick family dinners, while others expressed dissatisfaction over the restaurant's customer service and delivery issues. One customer reported a problem with their food being eaten before delivery and a lack of proper response to issues raised.

review_info.review_text:
The night of the issue with my pizza, I went to their website and left a description of what happened. As of today, I have not had a response via email or phone. 

That certainly sums it all up, unfortunately.
Rustys is great for family and quick family dinners. A little salty so you will be up all night but the pizza is definitely worth it!

So, I placed an order last night with Rusty's off of Carrillo for delivery, as I had many times over the last decades (SB local). I was VERY specific in my delivery details, as my house is behind the main house on the property. I am unit A. About an hour later, my neighbor knocked on my door and was holding my pizza. He told me that he found it on his back porch. I was stunned, but, thankful that he found it. 

I took the pizza inside and when I opened the box, the pizza was cold (no surprise) and there was a piece missing. Yep, somebody had eaten a piece of it. I know it wasn't my neighbor, which means it was likely the driver (?), or maybe it was done at the pizza joint and he didn't check the box?? Either way, I was completely disgusted. We are in the middle of a pandemic and somebody touched/ate my food.  UGH. 

I called and spoke with a supervisor (Jonathan) and told him the story and told him that the pizza was on my front porch, as I refused to eat it and refused to order a replacement (I just didn't trust them not to mess with my food.) The driver came back and grabbed the pizza and I am supposed to be getting a refund. We'll see if that really happens. 

I will not order food from them again, which makes me sad. I have a 40+ year history of patronage at Rustys, but, this is not okay. Too bad.

response: Pascucci is a local business located at 509 State St, Santa Barbara, CA. This restaurant specializes in Italian cuisine, including gelato, with options suitable for vegetarian and gluten-free diets. The establishment operates from 12 PM to 9 PM from Tuesday to Thursday, opens till 10 PM on Fridays and Saturdays, and starts service from 11:30 AM on weekends. They offer amenities such as free WiFi, outdoor seating, and group-friendly dining, although they do not accept reservations. The restaurant has an overall rating of 3.5 stars. While some customers praise the delicious food, particularly the Crème brûlée and ravioli sampler, and the ambiance, there are concerns about slow service and customer experiences with the staff. The venue also offers take-out options, making it a versatile choice for different dining preferences. The restaurant provides street and garage parking but does not offer validation or valet services.

review_info.review_text: Crème brûlée was delish. Service a little slow but expected during covid. Great ambiance and outdoor seating

It's hard enough to go out to dinner as a parent. Unfortunately for us, Laura (the hostess) was there to make it even more difficult. From the minute we started speaking to her she was unpleasant and dismissive. Our server (did not get her name) was very pleasant and offered to move us to the patio where it would be warmer. Our 2 year old started to fuss a bit, and Laura took it upon herself to let us know we would need to
move our stroller if she needed to sit someone next to us (there were several tables available... starting to see why). Less than a minute later, she sat the very next couple right next to us, as I was trying to wrangle my 2 year old. (Once again, plenty of tables). It was clear she did so to make us uncomfortable, and it worked. We decided to take our business elsewhere. It is really unfortunate since I've had so many pleasant experiences here, which I why I wanted to take my family. I can confidently say we will not be back.

We have enjoyed pascucci's for so many years now and just went tonight. It's always wonderful. I usually get the Bellagio pasta, but tonight got the ravioli sampler, in the mood to try each one. So good. Not sure which one was my favorite, had to keep tasting. We sat outside in a covered patio with a lovely warm heater. The garlic bread is such a treat. Such generous portions, went home with a great lunch for tomorrow. If I don't raid the fridge tonite....

Customers can make reservations at the restaurant and enjoy outdoor seating. The restaurant offers takeout and caters to groups. Wi-Fi is not available at the restaurant, and music and ambiance features are not provided.

review_info.review_text: It's a hotel bar that serves food. It's better than a Holiday Inn bar, but it's overpriced for the obviously low quality food ingredients. There's really nothing stellar or memorable about it. Order pizza in and spend half the money.

This is a review for Barra los Arcos which is the bar/lounge area across the lobby from Cafe los Arcos.

Last night a group of my friends and I got together to enjoy the Happy Hour at Barra los Arcos. I have to say, the service, the venue, and the view from the bar are all stellar! We found the seating to be comfortable and the place not overly crowded nor overly noisy on a Friday night. The bartender (I wish I knew his name) is one heck of a nice guy! So friendly and efficient. The House Chardonnay ($5/glass during HH) was delicious and the food was good (not super great but good) and served promptly. We were told they'd be happy to provide table service to us even if we located ourselves up on the landing/seating area just outside of the bar area (between the bar and the lobby). I was so impressed with the bartender's and the server's relaxed, easy-going, and yet eager-to-please approach. The HH extends to 7pm which is generous. Besides House Red and House White wine during HH, they also make available a beer on tap for $5 and a list of 5 or so appetizers at a reduced price including chips with gauc and salsa, egg rolls with chili sauce, or hummus dip with bread.

The Barra los Arcos outside patio is awesome as well. There is a variety of seating options there including chairs around tables, chairs around fire pits, and even two patio swings big enough for three people (although probably meant for two). It was a little too cool last night to sit outside but we will definitely be back to try that out on a warmer evening down the road.

My boyfriend's parents dined here recently and had a very disappointing experience:

Thanksgiving morning, we had breakfast at the Fess Parker's Santa Barbara resort's restaurant. First they wanted to seat us at a tiny table for two so we waited for a larger table. The table we were given was adjacent and protruding into the passage the waiters used to get and deliver the food. This table was also on a line to the scullery. As a result all through the meal waiters and busboys were quickly passing right by our table on the way to or from the kitchen and scullery. The constant back and forth was annoying and noisy. The noise from the dishes being placed in the scullery was extremely noisy and piercing to the ear. In addition it took three requests to get cream for Lynn's tea. The tea had cooled down considerably by the time the cream arrived. A design flaw placed the buffet foods adjacent to the outside row of dining tables. Those diners had people looking down at them as they gathered their food. For us the people gathering their food blocked our view to the outside courtyard. The waiters seemed overtaxed. Our waiter said they were not understaffed but overloaded with dinners. Seems at a quality restaurant there would be ample personnel to meet the needs of the diners. Lastly my ham was overcooked, dry and tough, the eggs were not prepared as requested, potatoes were so so, and the toast was hard. However, my wife's lox and bagel were wonderful. The only problem with her meal was that it included only one bagel. There was enough lox for at least two bagels, if not  a third. I reported all of the above in addition to the suggestion that they remove our table and go for quality rather than quantity to the concierge as there was no one else to report it to.
Out of a five point rating scale I would give it a one, and that is only because of the quality of the lox and bagel.

Jeannine's American Bakery Restaurant is a restaurant located at 3607 State St in Santa Barbara, CA. It offers various services such as catering, takeout, and outdoor seating. According to reviews, the restaurant provides a casual atmosphere with free WiFi and validated parking. Customers can order food at the counter and find seating either indoors or outdoors. 

The restaurant offers a variety of dishes including breakfast, brunch, bakery items, and coffee and tea. One of the most popular dishes is the banana Kahlua French toast, which is described as being fluffy and sweet with caramelized, Kahlua-glazed bananas on top. The Norwegian Benedict and breakfast burrito are also highly recommended.

Customers appreciate the friendly staff and the outdoor seating options. However, some have noted that finding a table for a large group can be challenging due to the limited space. Overall, Jeannine's American Bakery Restaurant is a beloved Santa Barbara establishment known for its delicious food and relaxed atmosphere.

source_info.name: Jeannine's American Bakery Restaurant
source_info.categories: Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Bakeries, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea

review_info.review_text: Amazing! Delicious! Can't say enough. From food to atmosphere to service. Just perfect. Right way to end a holiday weekend.

A Santa Barbara staple! I used to go to the downtown location, but after that one closed, I haven't been to Jeannine's since. Man, have I missed it!

You order at the counter and then find a table either indoors or outdoors. The space isn't too big, so if you're with a large group, it may be difficult to find seating. Staff was super friendly.

If you're a sweet brunch person, the banana Kahlua French toast is a MUST! The challah bread is fluffy and not too eggy as some french toasts can be, and the caramelized, Kahlua glazed bananas on top are sweet goodness. The Norwegian Benedict was nice and light with the smoked salmon, tomatoes, and cucumbers. The breakfast burrito was too heavy for me though. I loved the grilled tortilla, but the fillings alone were quite mushy. The crispy home fries on the side and salsa were much needed to add a bit of crunch and to cut the richness of the cheesy eggs and bacon. Nonetheless, Jeannine's honestly has a special place in my heart, and it's because of that banana Kahlua French toast!

Jeannine's is a nice breakfast and brunch spot across from the wharf with ocean views. I ordered a simple two egg breakfast with toast and fresh squeezed orange juice.  I placed a to go order and enjoyed my breakfast in the sand! 

The staff were very welcoming and quickly took my order. While I waited, I noticed how cute and quaint this place is. I was quickly served and left to the beach to enjoy. I would say my breakfast was about 3.5 and the juice and service was a 5! My eggs and potatoes were meh and sourdough was good. I think next time I will try a pastry (that seems to be the thing to get at Jeannine's).

Mesa Verde is a local business located at 1919 Cliff Dr in Santa Barbara, CA. It is a multi-category establishment that offers Garage Door Services, Restaurants, Live/Raw Food, Food, Home Services, Mediterranean, Keys & Locksmiths, Burgers, Vegetarian, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Vegan, and Salad options. The business operates from 11:00 am to 9:00 pm, Tuesday through Sunday.

Customers have left mixed reviews about Mesa Verde. One customer praised the restaurant for its fresh and inventive vegan options, specifically mentioning the delicious squash blossom quesadilla and friendly staff. However, another customer expressed disappointment with their experience. They found the food to be overpriced, lacking in flavor and presentation. They were particularly disappointed with the mushroom burger, which was served on a doughy bread and fell apart easily. The customer also mentioned that the side fries were not thoroughly cooked. They felt that the prices did not align with the quality of the food.

Despite the mixed reviews, Mesa Verde has an overall rating of 4.5 stars. It is known for its fusion and vegan food, with customers appreciating the spot-on flavors and good service. However, it is important to note that there have been mentions of fluctuating prices and varying quality.

Overall, Mesa Verde offers a variety of food options and has received both positive and negative feedback from customers.

source_info.name: Mesa Verde
source_info.categories: Garage Door Services, Restaurants, Live/Raw Food, Food, Home Services, Mediterranean, Keys & Locksmiths, Burgers, Vegetarian, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Vegan, Salad

review_info.review_text: It's always fun to try a new vegan place and this one doesn't disappoint. Super fresh, delicious and inventive. The squash blossom quesadilla was delicious (the blue corn tortilla was out of this world). The staff was also super friendly.

Pretty disappointing. I've been wanting to eat here for several years based on what I thought was a great reputation in town.  I don't get over to the Mesa much but when I saw a coupon in a mailed flyer a couple months ago, I clipped it.  It offered a free entree with purchase of one entree and two drinks. Even with a discount of $12, the bill was $53 for lunch (before tip) -- I can eat a great dinner out for less than this -- so I was expecting a very delicious meal.  Both my companion and I felt the food was vastly overpriced for the quality, flavor and even presentation. The quantity was generous enough but the items we ordered (empanadas and the mushroom burger) were both rather bland.  The "burger" was served on a doughy, barely cooked pita-like bread rather than on an appropriate item to hold a messy burger in place like a brioche bun.  It was completely falling apart after a few bites... which would have been okay to eat with a fork except it was just not flavorful or complex given the list of ingredients. The most interesting item was the ketchup made from beets.  Also the side fries weren't thoroughly cooked except for the smallest ones.  Definitely not a $24 item! The empanadas were somewhat better but again, not a 'wow' and not even a 'hey, really tasty.' Just bland and again, not worth $24.  The half-off discount didn't even cover the $13 cost of a chai tea and lemonade (that was mostly ice of course).  All in all, very disappointing food and therefore completely overpriced.  We took the food to go so I cannot really comment on the service. When I read another lengthy review (12/5/21), I now see that the prices have been jacked and the quality has been wavering. I totally understand the precarious state of the restaurant business right now during covid but I cannot recommend this restaurant at this time.
Flavors are always spot on! Service is also good. Best fusion snd vegan food in Santa Barbara.

The business operates seven days a week and has a wide variety of offerings, including beer and wine, sports bar selections, and outdoor seating. source_info.name: Barbarians
source_info.categories: Pizza, Bars, Sports Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife

review_info.review_text: The best pizza place in Santa Barbara by far. I'm a local here and I love Barbarians. It's always quiet for lunch and the service is great. They are one of the few places left that doesn't over charge for a meal. The people that work there are always super helpful and nice. At night after the bars close they get busy but they handle the rush perfectly. Highly recommend going to this place if you just want some god damn pizza without all the frills. State street is a bouchey touristy mess but this place is all right.

Now I'm not one to be dramatic, or really go out of my way to "yelp about it", nor do I usually care about bad service or bad food enough to write about it like some entitled douche with too much time on their hands, but I hope this place gets run out of town. I would give them a negative if I could. Pizza is 1 star quality. Really only good for late night when you're drunk, but hey that's one thing. It's another thing to have the rudest staff on state street. 

Fraternity Pizza: 
I waited 20 minutes, went up and asked if they called my number that I must have missed and they said no. They called 7 numbers ahead of mine at this point. Waited another 25 minutes, still no number called. When I went up again they said the ticket was 2 hours long and was accusing me of trying to get more. (Ticket said 12:56, it was 1:40am). I know my pic on here may say otherwise, but I'm no guy that's gonna slam 2 giant pieces of pizza and go up and try to get more, I'd go home and pass the fuck out. They were swamped so I get it, I've worked in the industry before. When asked if I could simply just get a refund or another order made they refused. I asked to speak with a manager (who apparently is also the cook). He told me he had a lot of people in line to worry about and proceeded to yell at me and how it was my fault. He also said I shouldn't have waited 2 hours to ask about it. Again I'm no mathematician, but it was now a full hour after arguing for 15 min trying to get things right. Him and 2 other people, one who was working the front and another cook proceeded to put their hands on me and tell me to leave. Note: I didn't raise my voice once or put my hands on anyone. Then I had drunk people butting in telling me it's only pizza, yada yada yada. Which it is, not that big of a deal, but it's simply the merit of making sure your customers get what they paid for. I felt like I was at a fraternity. 

Now I get it, it's known as a place for drunk people so I know they deal with some shit. But to simply push and yell at your customer out the door, because of your mistake will not keep you in business long. At least I hope not, Santa Barbara deserves better on State. After reading other reviews, it looks like this rudeness is a common occurrence, so I had to share. I knew I should have just gotten the mac n cheese at Velvet Jones
DO NOT EAT HERE. Slowww, Horrible service, staff was extremely rude and the pizza is over priced. Go eat somewhere else.

review_info.review_text: Overpriced slop, tiny portions of reheated oil saturated scraps, cheap cuts of meat with limp cabbage. Worst food I've ever had on campus and that's saying something .....

Wahoo's is a vibe. The food is bomb and it is a pretty chill spot to hang at. The service here is great! The only downside is typically the busyness of the establishment. Definitely worth eating here.

Bottom Line: Against all odds, an on-campus Wahoos is pretty good

Any time you go to get food on a campus, in an airport or a place like Fresno you dont quite know what you're getting.  You're trapped - they've got you by the tender bits.  You just have to ante up and hope for the best.... and often times the best is crap (figurative crap, not actual crap).

Don't ask me about the time I ordered a $16 Ceaser salad in the O'Hare airport....I will go on and on for hours about how crap it was, and then you'll leave and I will be here just talking to myself.


Anyways, when I was living in Los Angeles, every Wednesday my corworkers and I religiously went to the Wahoo's on Wilshire.  This carried on for years and we liked it (most of the time).
That location did suffer from being inconsistent but ultimately we liked the spot.

The other day, their Banzai burrito popped into my head and I had to have one.  Now living back in Santa Barbara, I enlisted a friend of mine who is UCSB alum to help me navigate the incredible bureaucracy that is even finding a place to park and paying for it, then walking the four miles to the Wahoo's location.

I of course had the glorious banzai burrito: the asada was tender, the green sauce was green....it was nicely hot inside and out and delicious.  I believe that they do use microwaves which isnt ideal but this burrito was as good as I remember any of them being for the many years that I got them in LA!

My buddy had the chicken sandwich and he really like it as well.

I will be back!!

review_info.review_text:
i've been really craving thai food and i've not have thai food in santa barbara. however, everything here is kind of subpar to me sadly (i say this as in i have had better) in a way, everything here is weirdly healthy??? still, i think they have a decent pad thai! their pineapple fried rice was just kind of plain and looks a little sad and not colorful. to be real idk how this stuff is cooked "authentically" but there's just something off about it. the egg roll was good, just a good ol egg roll. and their papaya salad was also okay! their curry was also okay i think everything was okay and i'm not mad at it just a little sad
their service is good! the ladies are super cute and they r the reason why i would go back

Excellent food great service. I'm found this place on a whim and so glad I did!
Go here get the curry and make sure you're able to get a Thai iced tea!

I love a pad thai, but so many places make them so heavy, this was crisp and bright flavored- so good.

Ordered some Pad Woon Sen for takeout in my hotel room,  I must say, the PWS exceeded my expectations.  It was flavorful and a delight with every mouthful.   The glass noodles and vegetables had the  right amount of chew.  It was such a satisfying meal.  Thumbs up to the chef!

response: Petrini's Restaurant is a family-owned and run establishment located in a strip mall in Goleta, CA. They serve traditional American-Italian cuisine, including pizza, pasta, and salads. The restaurant has a cozy and welcoming atmosphere, with attentive service and reasonable prices. The food is made fresh daily, and the sauces are homemade with Italian spices and fresh tomatoes. The menu includes vegetarian options, and takeout is available. Some of the popular dishes include onion and cheese pizza, garlic bread, and fettuccine Alfredo. However, some customers have reported inconsistent quality, with one reviewer expressing disappointment with the amount of butter and grease in their dish, while another praised the tenderness of the meat ravioli and the flavorful sauce. Overall, Petrini's Restaurant seems like a good option for those looking for traditional Italian food in a casual setting.

review_info.review_text: I tend not to expect much from food locations in Strip Malls.  While staying in the Santa Barbara area, I just wanted a good piece of Pizza. We stopped here while on a walk and ordered an onion and cheese pizza, small size.  Neither of us could believe how fresh and great it was! The sauce was a good homemade red with Italian spices and fresh tomato flavor. Just enough good cheese.  We stopped in twice after having such great luck.  Tried the salads, pasta and more pizza, garlic bread and wine.  Family owned and run place that's cordial and homey.   This is the kind of place you find in Chicago and New York. Just a little gem with friendly people and really good Italian food!

Well, I tried eating at this Petrini's again, and I'm really sad to report that the food has gotten worse AND more expensive. The Chicken Picatta was drowning in butter, or grease; I'm not sure what that was. The fettuccine Alfredo that came with it was undercooked and had zero taste. We also were served garlic bread that was burned to black. To make things worse, I took the food home because I just could eat it at the restaurant. I was hungry later so I ate it. 
Oh My God.....I couldn't keep it down. I got such a stomach ache from that food. Petrini's , you are a local restaurant and I really try to support local businesses, but you are bad for my health.

I have not been in here for many years, but we stopped in the other night and it was tasty traditional american italian food for a great price. The meat raviolis were very tender and delicious and the sauce was spot on. The spaghetti and meatballs (the yard stick for any italian review) were also very good. I also really enjoyed my cup of minestrone soup, really hit the spot. The waiters were very attentive and the place had a very welcoming and tidy atmosphere. 

The only downside, the water tasted horrible, I think they need to replace their filter or something.

The restaurant serves Chinese cuisine, with a focus on hot pot, pan Asian, and Szechuan food. They offer chicken wings and other menu items, and have indoor seating available. Based on customer reviews, the restaurant receives high praise for its homemade dumplings, friendly ownership, and good ambiance. The restaurant has been praised for its quality of food and attentive staff. It also offers a soft opening and serves Mala Tang, which is highly recommended by customers. However, some customers found the prices to be a little too high for what they were getting, and may not go back again. Overall, Jay C's Place seems to be a great option for those looking for delicious Chinese cuisine and a welcoming atmosphere.

review_info.review_text: This place always being one of my favourite! Friendly owner and Foods are sooooooooooo good! I love their homemade dumplings, Chicken popcorn, Taiwanese sausage, pork belly bowl, special carts noodle and lamp skewers!!

Place has amazing homemade dumplings that I can't get enough of. The staff is very nice and helpful. I went for the soft opening and while it wasn't perfect, they did all they could to make the service amazing, and it worked. They also serve Mala Tang, which I tried, and it was really good. The medium spicy is exactly as it sounds like. They also have other items I haven't tried yet but I will definitely go back for more!
A bit pricey for just a simple dumplings n malatang ( the spicy soup) ... But it taste good... Just not worthy to go back again.

response:
Mollie's is a local business located at 1218 State St in Santa Barbara, CA. It is categorized as an Italian, Pizza, and Restaurant establishment. The restaurant operates from Monday to Sunday, with opening hours from 17:30 to 21:30, except on Fridays and Saturdays when it closes at 22:00. The business offers valet parking and has a garage, but street parking is not available. They also accept reservations and offer takeout services.

Customer reviews provide insights into the dining experience at Mollie's. One customer mentioned enjoying the flavor of the Bolognese but expressed disappointment with the lasagna version, finding it overly sauced. The customer also reported getting sick from the Bolognese on a previous visit. They noted that the wait staff was friendly but slow, leading to a less desirable experience. Another customer found the food decent and enjoyed outdoor dining with live music. They praised the friendly servers and the amiable lady owner. However, a third review mentioned the worst service ever, with the owner being particularly rude. The customers were asked to place an order shortly after sitting down and ultimately decided to leave due to the owner's behavior.

Overall, Mollie's has a rating of 3.5 stars. While some customers have had positive experiences, others have encountered issues with the food and service.

review_info.review_text: I want to like this place. The flavor of the Bolognese is delicious. But I ordered the lasagna version this time and it was so smothered with sauce on a tiny little piece of lasagna I didn't know if the lasagna was really in the plate. This is also the second time I've gotten sick from eating the Bolognese. I had Bolognese not even two weeks ago at another restaurant in Montecito with no issues whatsoever so I'm not sure what they're putting in theirs at Mollies . The wait staff is very friendly but very slow. We wait too long to order we wait too long for the food we wait too long for the check. For the price it's just not a very desirable experience. I generally get places at least three tries before I make a decision but this time I think I'm done.

The food is decent.  There's a live band next door so we enjoyed the out door dining.  The servers were friendly. It did take a long time for our main entre to come out but we didn't mind since the live band was so good. The lady owner was quite friendly so I'm not sure what the guys are complaining about.

Worst service ever. The food actually looked really good but the owner was so rude. As we sat down she actually told us "you guys need to order already because we're busy" we had been sitting there for no more than 5 min to look at the menu. We decided to walk out and as we walked out she said "I'm glad you're leaving. Don't come back again" trust me we won't !

response: Bogo SB, located at 1114 State St, Santa Barbara, CA, is a popular local business known for its food delivery services, burgers, pizzas, catering, and event planning services. The restaurant offers free WiFi and takeout services. It has a high rating of 4.5 stars, with customers appreciating the quality of their food and the efficient customer service. Some standout items include their buy-one-get-one-free pizzas, flavorful burgers, and seasoned fries. Bogo SB is also acknowledged for its easy ordering process, often through Grubhub, and its efficient and friendly staff. While its operating hours vary, it is open every day of the week. Some customers have mentioned that the restaurant is located within another establishment, 1114, and operates separately from it.

source_info.name: Bogo SB
source_info.categories: Food, Food Delivery Services, Burgers, Pizza, Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants

review_info.review_text:
Good food, surprisingly easy ordering process. 

I often confuse this spot with Mizza and the adjoining 1114 restaurant. To my knowledge, they are under the same ownership. I order through Grubhub as all three spots offer crazy coupon discounts. Delivery, tax, and the driver fee will rack the price way back up so I opted to pick up from the location today. 

The restaurant is named after their buy one, get one free pizzas. I've tried and they are amazing! Great value. Tonight, I ordered a burger which is the same one cooked at 1114. It's large, full of flavor, and comes with a hearty serving of seasoned fries. 

BOGO is located within 1114. As soon as you enter the doors, take an immediate left where you will be greeted by a white counter with their logo. They appear to operate separately from the main restaurant. I was immediately helped by 3 different employees and appreciate how efficient they all were. My food was warm and packaged well!

I will be back soon.

Normally we get pizza here because it's always buy one get one free for pizza but I decided to get a burger, fries, cakes and beer. We decided to pick up the order and heads up, it has a sign that says eleven and is  near the turtle pond in the plaza behind Anderson's, near the museum, state and fig...I guess they took over eleven during covid?
I added lettuce and raw onions to my house burger and it was delicious. The chipotle sauce and angus burger patty combination went straight to my tummy and their beer batters fries adds a good texture.  We added a growler last minute and wife thought it looked like a juice jug. Lemon cake was ok but moist, but I ordered it for the wife and she said it reminded her of a cake from a grocery store.  The flourless chocolate cake had a thick fudge consistency- which I like but flavor wise was ok. Price for the cakes were not worth it in my opinion ( would rather go to Anderson's or lilac for that price). I will most likely order from here again- pizzas are good price and burgers were delicious.  Wife got Sb munchie burger so we could compare... I thought the burger here looked and tasted better

best place most amazing taste and the deal of a life time great customer service wow no more thinking on what and where to go its bogo all day thankx again for the delicious pies I ordered the caramelized onion and meatball and the BBQ chicken omg these are killer quality extra ricotta on the meatball one for just a  dollar

response: Root 217 is a casual restaurant located at 1180 UCen Rd, Goleta, CA. Open throughout the week, the eatery offers American (New) cuisine and sandwiches. While reservations are not accepted, the restaurant does provide free WiFi, takeout services and is suitable for groups. However, it does not offer outdoor seating or parking facilities. Despite its average 3-star rating, customer reviews are mixed. Some customers appreciate the healthy options, the ample serving sizes, and the decent pricing. However, there are negative reviews about the quality of the food, with incidents of uncooked ingredients and incorrect food orders leading to health issues reported. The restaurant's management was criticized for its handling of these situations.

review_info.review_text: I've ordered different things from here in the past which ranged from okay to good, never too outstanding but eh it's the UCen so you shouldn't expect too much. However today was a big shock, I had a breakfast burrito which at first seemed to be fine but the potatoes inside were totally uncooked, as if they had been slapped on a grill for 30 seconds and scooped onto the burrito. The other thing was that there was some kind of sour sauce inside of the burrito, which I assume should not have been sour. The reason I assume so is because not more than 15 minutes later that burrito had made me very sick, and I had to miss part of my class because I was in the bathroom with severe stomach pain. Wish I could have my money back; maybe this is why everyone goes to Panda instead.
There's a great atmosphere in the bottom floor of the UCen. Root 217 offers healthy options with big servings at a decent price.

I had a horrific experience here about a month ago and I have decided to write a review. I ordered the chickenless wrap, explicitly stating I wanted the vegan "chickenless"wrap. Once my order was ready I took a bite and immediately thought it was real chicken. I went back to the counter and the cashiers INSISTED it was vegan. I took it back not wanting to waste money and continued to eat it. My friend who is not a vegetarian had a bite and said that it was definitely real chicken. Again I went back and the cashier insisted. Then they brought the chef out and he looked at it and immediately said it was real. All they said was "oh sorry". Having not eaten meat in years I ended up being sick all night since my body was not used to digesting meat. No one who worked here cared or thought it was significant they made this mistake. They ended up giving me a refund only after I asked. This place is horribly mismanaged and if you are a vegetarian/vegan. DO NOT GO HERE !!!!!

review_info.review_text: We came here for drinks and appetizers. The place was relatively empty for a Saturday night...and I can see why. Just so mediocre! The ceviche we ordered was very bland with hardly any guacamole, and only a tiny portion of chips. For the price we paid, I expected better. I've given this restaurant a few chances before, mostly for the nice location- but will not be back.

What a great view. Come to the rooftop, sit outside and enjoy the sun or rain, ( it is covered) and take in the harbor view.  Bar food and family friendly. I wish they had a bigger selection of local craft beers but they do have good cocktail list. Plus if you are just enjoying happy hour they have popcorn and great list of happy hour bites. Relax, enjoy the harbor view. Update: Today we decided to order lunch, unfortunately turned out to be overpriced and mediocre. We had halibut tacos and seafood pasta. Beans and rice barely warm, tacos tasteless (added hot sauce); tortilla chips stale tasting, did not eat. Hubby says seafood pasta was "ok" nothing special. Would recommend coming here to sit outside, enjoy the view, popcorn, beer or cocktail but skip the menu.

I enjoyed my nachos; however, I did not care for customer service. I didn't leave tip and felt so uncomfortable by not but really trying to promote my gratitude when it's due and when there's a lack of, the same. I felt that "my group" had to wait longer than others and we were greeted by a receptionist/host that was not at her station so we saw sign that says it's ok to look for our seat, she hurried and corrected us that the sign should of been turned over, we needed to wait for assistance, we did, she joined us in looking for space. Our food again was tasty but throughout time we did not think we had experienced good customer service and so much that I did want to say thank you for what I considered less than mediocre service, my group didn't feel good.

review_info.review_text: Everything is average at best. No taste to meat. Bread was possibly older than a day in the way it tasted. They were very nice but it was not as good as a Subway ot any chain.

This place is a small deli and they sell sandwiches and sushi. I ordered a tri-tip sandwich from here. The sandwich came with a half-foot French bread with red onions, tomatoes, lettuce, and tri-tip with mayo. It was mostly bread and there was barely anything in the sandwich. Overall, it tasted okay and the service is quick.

Just randomly saw this place on Yelp today and had to go try it as I'm Asian so I'm always on the lookout for new Asian places to try because I need my Asian food fix from time to time -- it's a special diet I have :P

I was a little skeptical based on their seemingly random array of food selections but I went for it anyways despite my husband saying he wasn't impressed with a sandwich he got there once.

To my delight, this place was totally awesome! It's a cute little deli in an industrial area so they get a lot of foot traffic during lunchtime from all the workers nearby. There's indoor and outdoor seating and the cute Asian couple that owns it are so nice and sweet. 

I got the lunch combo with chicken teriyaki and California roll -- it comes with miso soup, rice, salad and 2 egg rolls. The miso soup was authentic and delicious, the teriyaki chicken was sweet/savory and grilled to perfection with bits of charred ends, the egg rolls were hot and crispy, the California roll was fresh and moist, and the salad was tossed with a tasty sesame ginger dressing. In terms of flavor, it's honestly on par with a lot of real Japanese restaurant bento lunches. 

It was also a lot of food for under $15! I couldn't finish it all so I'll also have leftovers to eat for dinner tonight. I have yet to try the other menu items but I'll be sure to come back again soon!

review_info.review_text: Go for the amazing signature cocktails, return for their incredible food. I wasn't disappointed. Filet Mignon was incredible.  Getting great service is rare. Whatever. Annoyed. Closed when the door and yelp said they were open. Not good food... because we didn't have any.

I love places that you can hang out, actually talk with your table and enjoy awesome food. We had the following:
Filet Steak Bite (Kashmiri almond sauce was the best!)
Curried Fish Tacos (good but not enough spice for my taste)
Hummus and flat bread were delicious
Onion Pakoras date tamarind chutney was a perfect balance
Nectar Fries tasty spices 
Chili Lemongrass Shrimp (scampi sauce with a little kick was amazing)
Chicken kebabs tender and juicy, loved the flavor

I will definitely keep coming back and different items and bring more friends. A really nice touch was that the owner Brad came around to say hi and check on food, drinks and service. We asked about his story and he told us about his experiences in the biz. It's great to see a locally owned restaurant doing well.

review_info.review_text: We loved this place! We stayed at the hotel for a couple of days and had most of our meals here. The staff was great as well as the owner who is really a great guy. I don't understand the negative reviews but I guess that happens time to time.

This place is really convenient if you're staying at the hotel in the same parking area. I ordered the ribeye and I gotta say the flavor is underwhelming  I guess I expected too much in that it would be steakhouse quality but it's not.  It's more like average coffee shop quality so I'm not impressed. The flavor also was lacking a bit as it's not seasoned all that well.

I'm not sure how this place is getting good reviews. I'm staying at the hotel because my daughter is hospitalized at cottage. Having to spend Thanksgiving in the hospital really bites but we were with family. My husband didn't want to eat the hospital food so suggested the restaurant. They had a special menu as it was Thanksgiving. I ordered it to go to eat dinner with our daughter. When I got it back to the hospital room I couldn't be more disappointed. $20 plate of barely any food. I let my husband eat mine and I had what the hospital served which was half the price double the food and better quality. I mean there were literally 4 green beans and 3 carrot slices in each container. We will not be eating here ever again. What a rip off.

review_info.review_text: We stopped by here for lunch. Aksum is a great option for Ethiopian food in Santa Barbara. The staff was super friendly and the food was delicious. Divey but endearing spot.

review_info.review_text:
Three Pickles, an innocuous name for a Goleta outpost with a local branch in downtown Santa Barbara, puts out a sandwich called The Goucho.  And that, friends, is just the beginning of a dream come true.  

This sandwich might just be at the very tippy top of the hot, messy, cheesy, roast beef creations I've ever sampled.  It's difficult to describe the coming together of the meat, cheese, and very little else -- there's optional bell peppers for those who want them -- piled high on a thin, crunchy and unbeatably tasty torpedo roll.  

Nice people here, working very hard to manage a large and obviously seasoned (no pun intended) repeat crowd of locals.  And to think I'd have never found it without the urging of friends whose home is serving as a retreat from the desert heat.  

The challenge:  staying away for at least a few days before I go back for another dive into sandwich nirvana.

My wife and always hope the Three Pickles sandwich shoppe is open when we fly into Santa Barbara Airport.  Today it was and they always deliver a great sandwich!.
Fast service, lots of options, well worth finding.
Only open from 10am to 3pm Monday through Friday.

I LOVE THIS PLACE. I come here for lunch breaks on work every so often and it is such a treat. I got the Goodland club the first time and now I can't get anything else it's so good!! My fiancé has had the meatball sub, pastrami, and Cuban. He loves them all but the Cuban takes the win. Super joyous atmosphere as well.
